title: Parishudh Machines Pvt. Ltd. v. Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Tarun Agarwala and Vipin Sinha, JJ. (final); R.K. Agrawal and Shashi Kant Gupta, JJ. (interim)
headnote: A writ challenging an additional-security demand under paragraph 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 was dismissed as infructuous on the petitioner's statement. An earlier 2009 listing order had, without prejudice and following a similar interim in W.P. No. 30582 of 2009, only restrained the licensee from demanding additional security until further orders; the Code question was never decided.
facts: The petitioner, an industrial consumer, challenged Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.'s demand notice dated 11 August 2009 seeking additional security under paragraph 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. Counsel pointed to an interim order of 23 June 2009 in Writ Petition No. 30582 of 2009 (M/s Vehlna Steels & Alloys Pvt. Ltd.). On 16 September 2009 the Court listed the matter with other similar 2009 petitions and, without prejudice, restrained the respondents from demanding additional security until further orders.

holding_units.holding: The writ petition challenging a demand for additional security under paragraph 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 was dismissed as infructuous on the petitioner's statement. The Court did not decide whether such additional security could be demanded. The 16 September 2009 order had only listed the petition with similar 2009 matters and, without prejudice to the parties' rights, restrained the licensee from demanding additional security until further orders.

not_decided.point: Whether additional security could be demanded under paragraph 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005
not_decided.note: The 2009 interim restraint was without prejudice; the petition was later dismissed as infructuous without a merits ruling.
